learningObjectives: Distinguish centralized test data from the automated test flow.
Check TestCase-Design availability and license access before practicing.
Confirm current Academy assessment rules in your own course account.
Recognize the difference between independent practice and an official Academy credential.

elements.text: TestCase-Design organizes test data; a Template models a reusable flow. Linking a TestSheet to a Template and instantiating it produces concrete automated TestCases. This local track provides independent notes and practice, not the Academy videos or solution workspaces. A useful study routine is to read the concept, build a small example, verify its assertions, and compare it with current documentation. Original course lesson counts, durations, transcript and workbook contents have not been verified.

The TestCase-Design AddIn is installed and enabled by default with a complete Tosca installation and requires a valid license. If disabled in Project > Options > TestCase-Design, it starts read-only after restarting Commander. Reuse a suitable working installation, but check its current license, AddIn and target-browser requirements; AS1 completion alone does not guarantee that these still work. Follow vendor-supported platform requirements rather than assuming every Windows VM on macOS is supported.

If your organization uses a cloud license server, first confirm your administrator added your account. In license configuration, select Setup > Change connection > Connect to Cloud hosted License Server and sign in using Support Hub credentials. Enable the default-proxy option when your environment requires it. A license prompt is not proof that the cloud connection alone is the cause; inspect the configured license source and available entitlement.

Use your current official Academy course account to confirm the pass mark, attempt allowance and any waiting period. These policies were not accessible during this review, so Quilyn does not assert a 60% threshold or a fixed retake schedule. Quilyn practice scores and saved attempts belong to this app and do not submit or satisfy an Academy assessment.

Completing local Quilyn practice does not issue a Tricentis credential. Consult the official Academy account for the reward and requirements of the course or learning path currently assigned to you. The linked support article and course assessment were inaccessible during this review; course-versus-path certificate rules and badge points are not certified here.

examPitfalls.title: Access can change
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming an earlier working installation guarantees current license access.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Check the enabled AddIn and current entitlement before editing data.

examPitfalls.title: Practice is separate from credentialing
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Treating a local quiz score as an official assessment submission.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use the official course account for current assessment and credential requirements.

practiceQuiz.scenario: You already have a suitable Tosca installation for template practice. What should you do before assuming you need a second installation?

options.text: Always install a second Tosca copy.
Always request a separate training license before checking the existing entitlement.
Assume previous AS1 completion guarantees current access.
Check the existing installation’s AddIn, current license and target requirements; reuse it if suitable.

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the documented responsibility and the authoritative source.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Checking current prerequisites permits reuse of a suitable installation.

optionExplanations.A: An unnecessary second installation is not the documented prerequisite.
optionExplanations.B: Check the available entitlement before requesting another license.
optionExplanations.C: Access and configuration can change after a previous course.
optionExplanations.D: Checking current prerequisites permits reuse of a suitable installation.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which division of responsibility supports centralized data-driven automation?

options.text: An ExecutionList replaces all input data definitions.
A Module alone defines every data combination and official assessment rule.
A TestSheet supplies data and a Template models the flow used to generate concrete TestCases.
The license server stores the business assertions for each test.

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the documented responsibility and the authoritative source.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The data source and flow model serve distinct roles in generation.

optionExplanations.A: An execution list organizes runs rather than replacing data design.
optionExplanations.B: A Module models technical controls, not all data combinations or assessment policy.
optionExplanations.C: The data source and flow model serve distinct roles in generation.
optionExplanations.D: Licensing grants access rather than defining business assertions.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Where should you verify the current AS2 official pass mark and attempt rules?

options.text: Assume every course uses 80% and unlimited attempts.
Use a previous course’s policy without checking.
Treat Quilyn’s local mastery threshold as the Academy pass mark.
Check the current official course account and assessment instructions.

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the documented responsibility and the authoritative source.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The current official instructions are the authoritative place to check.

optionExplanations.A: This unverified universal assessment policy is not justified.
optionExplanations.B: Policies can differ or change; prior-course assumptions are insufficient.
optionExplanations.C: Local mastery is an app setting, not official assessment policy.
optionExplanations.D: The current official instructions are the authoritative place to check.

practiceQuiz.scenario: What does completing a local Quilyn practice quiz establish?

options.text: A formal Tricentis certificate is issued automatically.
The results cannot be used for study feedback.
It records independent practice in Quilyn; official credentials require the Academy’s own process.
It automatically certifies the entire Product Consultant path.

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the documented responsibility and the authoritative source.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Local progress and official credentialing are separate processes.

optionExplanations.A: Local practice does not issue an official vendor certificate.
optionExplanations.B: Practice feedback remains useful even without an official credential.
optionExplanations.C: Local progress and official credentialing are separate processes.
optionExplanations.D: A quiz in this app cannot complete a vendor learning-path certification.

practiceQuiz.scenario: You need to generate automated TestCases using centrally designed test data. Which documented workflow fits?

options.text: Create execution logs first and use them as the test data definition.
Replace the data source with a browser TCP.
Copy screenshots of each input instead of linking data.
Link a TestSheet to a TestCase Template, check the data references, and instantiate concrete TestCases.

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the documented responsibility and the authoritative source.
practiceQuiz.rationale: This connects data to the model and generates concrete tests.

optionExplanations.A: Logs report execution; they are not the designed TestSheet workflow.
optionExplanations.B: Browser configuration is not the business-data source.
optionExplanations.C: Screenshots do not supply the linked instance values for generation.
optionExplanations.D: This connects data to the model and generates concrete tests.

quickRecap.value: TestSheet data feeds a Template for concrete TestCase generation.
Check current AddIn and license availability; previous course completion is not a current entitlement check.
Confirm current official rules in Academy; local practice does not issue a credential.
